// TricklePay contract event interface definitions
// Commit: example-commit-hash-abc123
// Repository: https://github.com/TricklePay/tricklepay-contracts

// Event: Created
// Topics: [event_name: Symbol, sender: Address, recipient: Address]
// Value: Map {
//   id: u64,
//   token: Address,
//   total_amount: i128,
//   start_time: u64,
//   end_time: u64,
//   cliff_time: u64
// }

// Event: Withdrawn
// Topics: [event_name: Symbol, recipient: Address]
// Value: Map {
//   id: u64,
//   amount: i128
// }

// Event: Cancelled
// Topics: [event_name: Symbol, sender: Address]
// Value: Map {
//   id: u64,
//   recipient_amount: i128,
//   sender_refund: i128
// }
